info.title: WhitePay API
info.description: Non-custodial USDT payments on Whitechain. Amounts in USDT are strings of base units (6 decimals). Fiat amounts on invoices are integers in minor units (cents/paise). Every response carries a WhitePay-Version header. Webhooks are signed: header `X-WhitePay-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + rawBody)>`.

bearer.description: Merchant secret API key (wp_test_… / wp_live_…). Server-side only. It decides which merchant every call acts for.

platform.description: Platform operator key (PLATFORM_KEY) for onboarding merchants.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retries with the same key return the original response instead of creating a duplicate.
